title: NAE Human Review Disposition Record v1
description: Design-only draft. See docs/NAE_HUMAN_REVIEW_DISPOSITION_SCHEMA_v1.md for full field rationale. Never validated against real 776-record data as of this draft's creation.

tsu_id.description: Immutable. Must reference an existing Production TSU record.

source_id.description: Immutable. Derived from the referenced TSU record.

work_id.description: Immutable. Derived from the referenced TSU record.

edition_id.description: Immutable. Derived from the referenced TSU record.

review_status.description: Mutable ONLY via the state machine in docs/NAE_HUMAN_REVIEW_WORKFLOW_v1.md SS2. Every transition must be recorded in a separate append-only provenance log (docs/NAE_HUMAN_REVIEW_GOVERNANCE_v1.md SS4.3).

disposition.description: Required once review_status reaches DISPOSITIONED. Append-only — a changed disposition means a new record via supersedes_review_id, never an edit.

reason_code.description: Required once disposition is set. Independent axis from disposition (see schema doc SS1.2).

review_note.description: Required if reason_code includes OTHER. Otherwise optional.

evidence_refs.description: Required once disposition is set. References only — no original artifact bodies are duplicated into this record (docs/NAE_HUMAN_REVIEW_GOVERNANCE_v1.md SS3).

previous_disposition.description: Set only when this record supersedes an earlier one (re-review).

supersedes_review_id.description: review_id of the record this one replaces. The superseded record is never deleted or edited.

final_disposition.description: Set by the adjudicator only. The original conflicting reviewer records are preserved unchanged.

ref.description: Reference string (e.g. 'source_id:BAP-CHURCH-DAGG-001#page=42', 'tsu_id:TSU-0000123', a URL, or free-text citation for external_authority).
